illustrations.composition: A close view of one ordinary hexagonal wooden graphite pencil lying diagonally from upper-left toward lower-right, its sharpened wooden tip and thin dark graphite core clearly exposed and separated in silhouette. A short loose graphite writing trace touches the sharp graphite tip. No hand, no metal lead, no packaging or brand marks. Entire pencil and trace visible with large white margins.

illustrations.composition: A simple object study of pencil-core ingredients: a rough layered graphite rock on the upper-left, one smooth irregular lump of clay on the upper-right, and a thin cylindrical pencil core horizontally below them. Two simple open curved arrows descend separately from graphite and clay toward the pencil core. Graphite rock has darker dense scribble lines; clay has lighter sparse contour strokes. No lettering, labels, numbers or hands. All three objects separated by clean white space.
